sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super
sources.snippet: We are releasing NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super, a 12B active 120B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts hybrid Mamba-Transformer model. Nemotron 3 Super is the first model in the Nemotron 3 series that leverages Latent MoE, includes MTP Layers, and was pre-trained in NVFP4.
